description: This file defines the List feature for articles, including a request query, its handler, and the logic to filter and retrieve articles based on tags, author, favoriters, and user feed status in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A record defining the parameters for querying articles, including filtering options by tag, author, favoriters, along with pagination and feed options.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the processing of the query, applying filters, and retrieving articles from the database.

methods.name: List.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the article retrieval logic based on query parameters, including user-specific feed filtering, tag, author, and favorited filtering, and returns an envelope with the list of articles.
